Let’s be crystal clear as we head into 2028: Gavin Newsom is a traitor to the cause.

While working families are drowning in unaffordable housing, record homelessness, and the highest cost of living in the nation, Newsom has spent years in Sacramento perfecting the art of the slick photo-op and the donor-class handshake. 

He vetoes the boldest progressive legislation, cozies up to Silicon Valley billionaires, and then has the audacity to position himself as the savior of the Democratic Party.
